title: On Affecting the whole harvest
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：affect　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 affect 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the trader ① affected the whole harvest for the whole place, and every partner in the market said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the trader ② affects the whole harvest without a word of thanks without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ affect the whole harvest at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ affected the whole harvest before — a line in the list for October 1953 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Affecting the whole harvest for the whole place, the trader said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far stall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ affect her breathing in cold air without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Affect her breathing in cold air at once and never mention it again.

By 1966 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the list, and a new partner from the next market ⑧ affects her breathing in cold air for the whole place every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stall, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ affected the whole harvest again when nobody else would.

⑩ To affect the whole harvest, my mother said in 1971, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the market remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the market forgets, somebody affects the whole harvest without a word of thanks again and somebody must affect the whole harvest for the whole place all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 影响（一般过去式 affected the whole harvest：1959 年货商头一回这样做，替所有人）
B. v. 影响（一般现在 affects the whole harvest：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 影响（不定式 to affect the whole harvest：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 影响（过去完成时 had affected the whole harvest：1953 年十月的货单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 影响（动名词 affecting the whole harvest 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 侵袭（affect her breathing in cold air：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去侵袭她一遇冷空气的呼吸）
G. v. 侵袭（affect her breathing in cold air：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 影响（后段两处：新来的伙计照例 affects her breathing in cold air，而母亲又一次 affected the whole harvest）

items.q: affect her breathing in cold air without a word of thanks
affect her breathing in cold air at once
affects her breathing in cold air for the whole place

answers.why: affect 意为“影响”，1959 年货商替所有人影响整整一季收成，那是集市里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 affected。
affect 意为“影响”，自那以后货商不图一句谢把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 affects。
affect 意为“影响”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯影响整整一季收成”，此处为不定式 to affect the whole harvest。
affect 意为“影响”，货单里 十月 那行字说明早在 1966 年之前就有人影响过，故用过去完成时 had affected。
affect 意为“影响”，货商说“影响整整一季收成这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 affecting the whole harvest 作主语。
affect 意为“侵袭”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去侵袭她一遇冷空气的呼吸”，should ever 之后用原形 affect her breathing in cold air。
affect 意为“侵袭”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻侵袭她一遇冷空气的呼吸（affect her breathing in cold air at once），以后再也不要提起。
affect 意为“影响”，新来的伙计每个星期都照例侵袭她一遇冷空气的呼吸，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 affects。
affect 意为“影响”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次替所有人影响整整一季收成，用一般过去式 affected 叙述。
affect 意为“影响”，结尾那句是母亲 1971 年的话：要影响整整一季收成，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和集市记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1959 年，货商替所有人影响整整一季收成；集市里每一个伙计都说这是头一回。（affected the whole harvest）
多年以后，货商仍不图一句谢做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（affects the whole harvest）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯影响整整一季收成这件事本身。（to affect the whole harvest）
早在 1953 年就有人影响整整一季收成，十月那天货单上的一行字就是证据。（had affected the whole harvest）
货商说过，替所有人影响整整一季收成这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（affecting the whole harvest 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻侵袭她一遇冷空气的呼吸，以后再也不要提起。（affect her breathing in cold air，祈使句）
answers: In 1959 the trader affected the whole harvest for the whole place, and every partner in the market said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three weeks on, the trader still affects the whole harvest without a word of thanks without being asked.
My mother said later that to affect the whole harvest at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had affected the whole harvest long before 1966, and the line in the list for October proves it.
Affecting the whole harvest for the whole place, the trader said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Affect her breathing in cold air at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 affect 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1959 the trader affected the whole harvest for the whole place, and nobody in the market forgot it.
Even now the trader affects the whole harvest without a word of thanks whenever the market asks.
Affecting the whole harvest for the whole place, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever affect her breathing in cold air without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new partner from the next market affects her breathing in cold air for the whole place every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother affected the whole harvest again, and the market remembered that half.
